newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FNB appoints Bartlett managing director.
newsitem.headline: FNB appoints Bartlett managing director.

text.p: South Africa's First National Bank Holdings Ltd on Tuesday appointed executive director Viv Bartlett as its new managing director, replacing Barry Swart who left after a row over the award of decorating contracts.
First National Bank board chairman Basil Hersov said he was confident Bartlett's management skills would serve the group well into the future.

Bartlett's carrer with FNB began in 1961 with Barclays Bank and he was managing director of First National Industrial Bank in 1989 before his appointment as senior general manager and chief financial officer of First National Bank in 1990.
In May 1996 he was appointed executive director of First National Bank.
On Monday, the bank said Swart would be taking early retirement after being censured by the board for awarding bank re-decorating contracts to his daughter.
It said discussions had taken place between Swart and the board of First National Bank and Swart had indicated that he wished to take early retirement which the bank had agreed to.
Swart said on Monday he would be standing down with immediate effect.
